questions.prompt: Which of these are gases at room temperature?
questions.fact: Mercury and bromine are the only two elements that are liquid in a warm room.

questions.prompt: Which of these rivers flow through Europe?
questions.fact: The Danube passes through ten countries, more than any other river in the world.

questions.prompt: In which year was the first Star Wars film released?
questions.fact: It opened in only 32 cinemas. The studio expected it to fail and let its director keep the sequel rights.

questions.prompt: How many teeth does an adult human usually have?
questions.fact: 32, counting the four wisdom teeth that many people never grow at all.

questions.hint: It began in Naples, as cheap food for workers.
questions.fact: The Margherita is named after a queen, and its colours match the Italian flag.

questions.prompt: Which band recorded the album Abbey Road?
questions.hint: Four of them, photographed on a zebra crossing.
questions.fact: The cover was shot in ten minutes on the street outside the studio. The crossing is now a listed landmark.
